sources.snippet: Aloha! 🌺 Ornith is a family of self-improving open-source models for agentic tasks. This repo covers both generations: 🐦 Ornith-1.5 (latest) — extends self-scaffolding into a complete end-to-end self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning. sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.
